I scraped a dataset of every Catholic church in the United States. What follows are some questions that I wanted to explore.

# Data Loading

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

church_data <- read_csv("national_church_data.csv") %>%
  # selects just US churches, and those w valid coords
  filter(church_address_country_territory_name == "United States",
         !(is.na(latitude)))

# cleans up, calculates fields
worship_freq <- read_csv("national_worship_times.csv") %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = starts_with("time"),
                .fns = ~ hms(.)),
         time_length = time_end - time_start,
         time_length = if_else(time_length < 0, time_length * -1, time_length),
         time_length_hours = as.numeric(time_length, "hours")) %>%
  group_by(psuedo_id, service_typename) %>%
  summarize(ct = n(),
            num_hrs = sum(time_length_hours, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = service_typename,
              values_from = c(ct, num_hrs)) %>%
  select(psuedo_id,
         num_weekday_mass = `ct_Week Days`,
         num_weekend_mass = ct_Weekend, 
         num_hrs_conf = num_hrs_Confessions) %>%
  mutate(across(.cols = starts_with("num"),
                .fns = ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# adds data to church data
church_data <- church_data %>% 
  left_join(worship_freq, join_by(psuedo_id))

ggplot(church_data, aes(x = num_weekend_mass)) +
  geom_histogram()

ggplot(church_data, aes(x = num_hrs_conf)) +
  geom_histogram()

ggplot(church_data, aes(x = num_hrs_conf, y = num_weekend_mass)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Correlation of Confession Hours and Weekend Masses",
       x = "Confession Hours",
       y = "Weekend Masses")
```

# Census Overlap

Now I want to run some analyses using `tidycensus` data... starting with basic demographic information.

```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidycensus)

church_data_sf <- church_data %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
           crs = 4326)

# census variables to grab
acs_vars <- c(
  pop_total    = "B01003_001E",
  pop_65plus   = "B25033_001E",
  pop_under18  = "B25033_002E",
  median_age   = "B01002_001E",  # <-- proper median age var
  white        = "B03002_003E",  # White alone
  black        = "B03002_004E",
  hispanic     = "B03002_012E",
  owner_occ    = "B25003_002E",
  renter_occ   = "B25003_003E",
  vacant_units = "B25002_003E")

# ACS data @ tract level (for one state at a time)
tract_data_dl <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  variables = acs_vars,
  state = "KY",
  year = 2019,
  geometry = TRUE) %>%
  select(GEOID, variable, estimate, geometry)

# puts labels into proper order
var_labels <- tibble(
  variable = acs_vars,
  label = names(acs_vars))

# joins proper labels, sets them as column names
tract_data <- tract_data_dl %>%
  mutate(variable = paste0(variable, "E")) %>%
  left_join(var_labels, by = "variable") %>%
  select(GEOID, label, estimate, geometry) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = label,
    values_from = estimate)

# derived measures
tract_data <- tract_data %>%
  mutate(
    pct_65plus   = pop_65plus / pop_total * 100,
    pct_under18  = pop_under18 / pop_total * 100,
    pct_white    = white / pop_total * 100,
    pct_black    = black / pop_total * 100,
    pct_hispanic = hispanic / pop_total * 100,
    # density      = density(geometry, pop_total), # tidycensus helper
    vacancy_rate = vacant_units / (owner_occ + vacant_units) * 100)

# church data
churches <- church_data_sf %>%
  st_transform(4269)

# churches to census tracts
churches_with_tract <- st_join(churches, tract_data, join = st_within)

# count churches per tract
tract_with_churches <- churches_with_tract %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  count(GEOID, name = "n_churches") %>%
  right_join(tract_data, by = "GEOID") %>%
  # fills NA (i.e., those w/o any churches) as 0
  mutate(n_churches = ifelse(is.na(n_churches), 0, n_churches),
         church_density = n_churches / st_area(geometry) * 1e6,
         church_per_10k = n_churches / pop_total * 10000) %>%
  filter(!is.infinite(church_per_10k)) %>%
  st_as_sf # per sq km
```

# LLM

```{r}
library(mall)
library(ellmer)

chat <- ellmer::chat_google_gemini(model = "gemini-2.0-flash-lite")
# ensures use of Gemini model
llm_use(chat, seed = 100, temperature = 0)
# llm_use("ollama", "llama3.1", seed = 100, temperature = 0)

my_prompt <- paste(
  "Answer a question.",
  "Return only the answer, no explanation",
  "Acceptable answers are a recognized (by the Catholic Church) Saint's name",
  "Formatted as 'St. ___'. Return the underlying patron when referenced by a devotion",
  "E.g., star of the sea = St. Mary, or, return a value of NA for something like 'Holy Spirit' (or if unsure)",
  "When multiple saints are detected, list them both separated by a semicolon (e.g., St. Paul; St. Peter)",
  "Answer this about the following text, What is the patron Saint's name?:"
)

church_data_llm <- church_data %>%
  llm_custom(name,
             my_prompt,
             pred_name = "patron")
```

## Determining Distribution of Patrons

```{r}
library(spdep)

patron_data <- church_data_llm %>%
  select(psuedo_id, patron)

lw <- church_data_sf %>%
  st_coordinates() %>%
  knearneigh(k = 5) %>%
  knn2nb() %>%
  nb2listw(zero.policy = TRUE)

# rewritten to calculate thiessen polygons

# plots thiessen polygons
library(rmapshaper)
library(mapview)

voronoi_polygons <- church_data_sf %>%
  st_combine() %>%
  st_voronoi() %>%
  st_collection_extract() %>%
  st_intersection(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(church_data_sf)))

voronoi_polygons <- tryCatch({
  church_data_sf %>%
    st_combine() %>%
    st_voronoi() %>%
    st_collection_extract() %>%
    st_intersection(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(church_data_sf)))
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Error in voronoi creation. Attempting a simplified approach...")
  church_data_sf %>%
    st_union() %>%
    st_voronoi() %>%
    st_collection_extract() %>%
    st_intersection(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(church_data_sf)))
})

church_data_sf_proj <- st_transform(church_data_sf, crs = 3857)

voronoi_polygons <- tryCatch({
  st_combine(church_data_sf_proj) %>%
    st_voronoi() %>%
    st_collection_extract() %>%
    st_intersection(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(church_data_sf_proj)))
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Error in voronoi creation. Attempting a simplified approach...")
  st_union(church_data_sf_proj) %>%
    st_voronoi() %>%
    st_collection_extract() %>%
    st_intersection(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(church_data_sf_proj)))
})

church_data_v <- st_join(st_sf(voronoi_polygons, crs = st_crs(church_data_sf_proj)),
                         church_data_sf_proj,
                         join = st_intersects)

mapview(church_data_v, 
        zcol = "num_hrs_conf")

moran.test(as.numeric(as.factor(church_data_sf$num_conf)), listw = lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
```

## Estimating Age of the Church Building

```{r}
library(rvest)
library(stringr)
library(xml2)
library(mall)
library(tidyr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)


get_church_history_robust <- function(base_url) {
  
  if (is.na(base_url) || base_url == "") {
    return(NA)
  }
  
  # 1. Clean Protocol
  if (!str_detect(base_url, "^http")) {
    base_url <- paste0("http://", base_url)
  }

  tryCatch({
    # 2. Start Session
    sess <- session(base_url, user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) Chrome/115.0.0.0 Safari/537.36")
    
    # 3. Smart Link Prioritization
    # We grab ALL links first, then filter logic in R
    all_links <- sess %>% html_elements("a")
    link_text <- html_text(all_links) %>% str_trim()
    link_href <- html_attr(all_links, "href")
    
    # Priority 1: Look for explicit "History" (ignoring case)
    match_idx <- grep("History|Our Story|Parish History", link_text, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]
    
    # Priority 2: If no History, look for generic "About" or "Welcome"
    if (is.na(match_idx)) {
      match_idx <- grep("About|Welcome", link_text, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]
    }
    
    # 4. The "Safe Jump" (Fixes your error)
    if (!is.na(match_idx)) {
      target_href <- link_href[match_idx]
      
      # Convert relative path (/sacraments) to absolute (http://site.org/sacraments)
      absolute_url <- url_absolute(target_href, base = sess$url)
      
      # Try to jump, but if it fails (404), keep the homepage session
      sess <- tryCatch({
        sess %>% session_jump_to(absolute_url)
      }, error = function(e) sess)
    }

    # 5. Extract Text (The "Nuclear" High-Recall Method)
    # We grab the whole body. The LLM is smart enough to ignore the menu text.
    # We strip extra whitespace to keep the token count manageable.
    page_text <- sess %>% 
      html_element("body") %>% 
      html_text2()
      
    if (length(page_text) == 0 || is.na(page_text)) return(NA)
    
    # Truncate to first ~15,000 characters to save LLM costs/tokens
    # (The founding date is almost always in the first few paragraphs)
    return(str_sub(page_text, 1, 15000))

  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NA) # If the site is dead, return NA
  })
}

# 3. Apply the LLM extraction
church_data_w_txt <- church_data %>%
  mutate(clean_url = str_trim(url),
    clean_url = if_else(str_detect(clean_url, "^http"), 
                        clean_url, 
                        paste0("http://", clean_url))
  ) %>%
  # NOTE: This part requires you to scrape the text first
  mutate(website_text = map_chr(url, get_church_history_robust, .progress = TRUE))

# 1. Define the Prompt
# Notice we explicitly ask for JSON and provide the keys
json_prompt <- paste(
  "Analyze the text and extract the following details into a valid JSON object.",
  "Keys:",
  "- 'founding_year': (integer or null)",
  "- 'languages': (list of strings, e.g. ['Spanish'])",
  "- 'has_school': (boolean)",
  "- 'num_priests': (integer, count distinct names)",
  "Return ONLY the JSON object, no markdown formatting.",
  "Text:"
)

# 2. Run the LLM (Creates one column containing the JSON string)
church_data_json <- church_data_w_txt %>%
  llm_custom(
    col = website_text, 
    prompt = json_prompt,
    pred_name = "raw_json" # The new column name
  ) 

# 3. Unpack the JSON into real columns
church_data_final <- church_data_json %>%
  # Helper to safely parse JSON (returns NA if LLM hallucinates bad format)
  mutate(parsed = map(raw_json, ~ tryCatch(fromJSON(.), error = function(e) NULL))) %>%
  # Expand the list column into your actual variables
  unnest_wider(parsed)

# View results
glimpse(church_data_final)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(stringr)
library(xml2)
library(mall)
library(jsonlite)
library(ellmer)

# --- STEP 1: DEFINE THE SCRAPING FUNCTION ---
get_church_history_robust <- function(base_url) {
  
  # Guard Clause: Skip empty/NA URLs immediately
  if (is.na(base_url) || base_url == "") {
    return(NA)
  }
  
  # 1. Clean Protocol
  if (!str_detect(base_url, "^http")) {
    base_url <- paste0("http://", base_url)
  }

  tryCatch({
    # 2. Start Session (Act like a browser)
    sess <- session(base_url, user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) Chrome/115.0.0.0 Safari/537.36")
    
    # 3. Smart Link Prioritization
    all_links <- sess %>% html_elements("a")
    link_text <- html_text(all_links) %>% str_trim()
    link_href <- html_attr(all_links, "href")
    
    # Priority 1: Explicit "History"
    match_idx <- grep("History|Our Story|Parish History", link_text, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]
    
    # Priority 2: Generic "About"
    if (is.na(match_idx)) {
      match_idx <- grep("About|Welcome", link_text, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]
    }
    
    # 4. The "Safe Jump"
    if (!is.na(match_idx)) {
      target_href <- link_href[match_idx]
      absolute_url <- url_absolute(target_href, base = sess$url)
      
      sess <- tryCatch({
        sess %>% session_jump_to(absolute_url)
      }, error = function(e) sess)
    }

    # 5. Extract Text
    page_text <- sess %>% 
      html_element("body") %>% 
      html_text2()
      
    if (length(page_text) == 0 || is.na(page_text)) return(NA)
    
    # Truncate to save tokens
    return(str_sub(page_text, 1, 15000))

  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NA) 
  })
}

# --- STEP 2: RUN THE SCRAPE ---
# (Recommended: Run on a small sample first using head(5))

church_data_scraped <- church_data %>%
  # 1. Clean URLs and remove missing ones to prevent errors
  mutate(clean_url = str_trim(url),
         clean_url = if_else(str_detect(clean_url, "^http"), 
                             clean_url, 
                             paste0("http://", clean_url))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(clean_url)) %>%
  sample_n(1000) %>%
  # 2. Scrape (This takes time!)
  mutate(website_text = map_chr(clean_url, get_church_history_robust, .progress = TRUE))

# --- STEP 3: CONFIGURE LLM ---
chat <- ellmer::chat_google_gemini(model = "gemini-2.0-flash-lite")
llm_use(chat)

# --- STEP 4: DEFINE PROMPT & EXTRACT ---
json_prompt <- paste(
  "Analyze the text and extract the following details into a valid JSON object.",
  "Keys:",
  "- 'founding_year': (integer or null, year established/founded)",
  "- 'languages': (list of strings, e.g. ['Spanish', 'Vietnamese'])",
  "- 'has_school': (boolean, true if K-8 school is mentioned)",
  "- 'num_priests': (integer, count distinct names of current clergy)",
  "Return ONLY the JSON object, no markdown formatting.",
  "Text:"
)

# 1. Ensure the prompt variable name matches what you use inside llm_custom
# (You defined 'json_prompt' earlier, so use that variable name)
my_prompt <- json_prompt 

church_data_final <- church_data_scraped %>%
  # FIX: Filter both NA *and* empty strings to prevent HTTP 400 errors
  filter(!is.na(website_text), website_text != "") %>%
  
  # Optional: Filter out text that is too short to be useful (e.g., "Coming Soon")
  filter(nchar(website_text) > 50) %>%

  # 2. Run LLM
  llm_custom(
    col = website_text, 
    prompt = my_prompt, # Make sure this matches your defined variable
    pred_name = "raw_json"
  ) %>%
  
  # 3. Clean & Parse (Same as before)
  mutate(raw_json = str_remove_all(raw_json, "```json|```")) %>%
  mutate(parsed = map(raw_json, ~ tryCatch(fromJSON(.), error = function(e) NULL))) %>%
  unnest_wider(parsed)

# View final results
glimpse(church_data_final)
```
